description: This file is a shell script used for bumping kernel versions within the OpenWrt project. It contains functions for version management, git operations, and script initialization, along with usage instructions and requirement checks.

methods.name: _msg
methods.description: Outputs a message with a specified log level, used internally for error, warning, and notice messages.

methods.name: e_err
methods.description: Logs an error message to standard error.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Restores git state and cleans up temporary states upon script exit.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes script environment, checks repository state, and sets up variables.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Performs the main kernel version bump operations, including git file renaming and merging.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Checks for required external commands necessary for script execution.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point handling argument parsing, validations, and orchestrating the bump process.
